services.name: 2-Hr Shared Booze Cruise
services.desc: Passengers - $80.00 Must pay for minimum of at least 10 passengers even if group size is smaller than 10 passengers This is a Shared Booze Cruise No Swimming on 2-hr trips 2 Hours About Enjoy this SHARED BYOB booze cruise in Ocean City, MD. Celebrate however you want while knowing that you are in a safe environment and will make great memories...hopefully you can remember them the next morning! What's Included Licensed Captain Two decks (top deck open air) Private bathroom Two large coolers full of ice Bluetooth music hook up Speakers on both decks Tables for food $50.00 per person · Minimum of 6 people

services.name: 2-Hr Private Boat Party
services.desc: Passengers - $80.00 Must pay for a minimum of at least 15 passengers even if group size is smaller than 15 passengers 2 Hours NO SWIMMING ON 2-hr trips About All of our Boat Party options are completely private for you and your friends! The double deck party boat is all yours so BYOB and food and party hard like there's no tomorrow!! What's Included Licensed Captain Two decks (top deck open air) Private bathroom Two large coolers full of ice Bluetooth music hook up Speakers on both decks Tables for food $80.00 per person · Minimum of 15 people or pay for the minimum price as though you had 15 people.

services.name: Sunset Boat Cruise
services.desc: Passengers - $80.00 PER PERSON 2 Hours IF WE DON'T GET AT LEAST 8 PAYING PASSENGERS THEN THE TRIP WILL BE CANCELED AND YOU WILL RECEIVE A FULL REFUND About On the sunset boat tour discover Ocean City MD, and Assateague Island in a whole new way!! Every one of our sunset cruises are unique because of the incredible views. You also have a higher chance seeing dolphins coming in from the ocean. Most people like to bring a couple bottles of wine to celebrate special occasions. The standard sunset boat tours are Monday-Thursday ONLY and 2hrs long. We also offer private date nights 2 Hours · Available ONLY Monday-Thursday

services.name: Island Adventure

You can bring all the food and alcohol that you wish. After anchoring the boat you will have access to an assortment of floats and be within walking distance of a small beach.
